_comment: PURPOSE: judge the on-map sprite anchor MYSELF on a real map frame. User 2026-07-26: 'start with peasant, build a spearman, make sure they are appearing center mass on the map'. PASS 1 (run 20260726-081359) measured two blockers, both fixed here: (1) the map viewport never painted -- chrome drew, terrain stayed black; (2) all four post-'enter' frames were BYTE-IDENTICAL, i.e. the turn never advanced. (2) is exactly ctp2-endturn-needs-mouse-input: the injected key only lands if some mouse message reached the engine that turn. Cure for both is the same engine ping at inert top-bar chrome (600,6). Run with --save none.

(600,6) is empty chrome in the top menu bar, between the Options menu and the gold readout -- nothing is hit-tested there, so this delivers a mouse message without activating a control. This is the ONLY posted click in the file; every UI action below is injection or a key.
PREDICTION: scrolling the view damages the whole viewport and forces terrain to paint. If these frames are still black the thesis is wrong and the repaint trigger is something else.

Found the city, then QUEUE Spearmen: UnitsList index 0 (measured in pass 1 -- Spearmen/Minotaur/Peasants at 8/12/14 turns, so unit costs are sane too). Add > appends it to the build queue; no Rush Buy, because gold is 106 and a rush-buy confirm is a modal that would freeze captures.

Nine pinged end-turns. Spearmen is an 8-turn build, so it completes inside this window. Each turn: ping first, THEN enter -- order matters, the key is what advances and the ping is what makes the key count.
Scroll once more so the tile holding the new unit is guaranteed freshly painted, then capture the frame the verdict is read off.
